import json,subprocess,sys,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
R=Path.cwd();catalog=R/'data/openjudge/catalog.json';page=R/'data/openjudge/pages/practice__31178.html';book=R/'data/openjudge/books/practice__11.html';limits=R/'data/openjudge/limits.json'
backups={p:p.read_bytes() for p in (catalog,page,book,limits)};rows=[]
def run(name,path,edit):
 try:
  path.write_bytes(edit(backups[path]));p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','unittest','tests.test_gmyhf_normal_activation'],capture_output=True,text=True)
  assert p.returncode!=0,(name,p.stdout,p.stderr);rows.append({'mutation':name,'detected':True,'exit_code':p.returncode})
 finally:path.write_bytes(backups[path])
def cat_edit(fn):
 def edit(raw):
  data=json.loads(raw);item=next(r for r in data['problems'] if r['book']=='practice' and r['id']=='31178');fn(data,item);return json.dumps(data,ensure_ascii=False).encode()
 return edit
run('global_number错绑',catalog,cat_edit(lambda d,r:r.update(global_number=31200)))
run('tests标记停用',catalog,cat_edit(lambda d,r:r.update(tests=False)))
run('漏掉测试点',catalog,cat_edit(lambda d,r:r['test_cases'].pop()))
run('数据路径串题',catalog,cat_edit(lambda d,r:r['test_cases'][0].update(input='tests/30000-/31200_made/data/0.in')))
run('题面全局号错绑',page,lambda b:b.replace(b'<dd>31178</dd>',b'<dd>31200</dd>'))
run('样例被改坏',page,lambda b:b.replace(b'Hello, OJ Inject!',b'Wrong sample'))
run('目录链接丢失',book,lambda b:b.replace(b'/practice/31178/',b'/practice/31179/'))
def badlimit(raw):
 d=json.loads(raw);d['limits']['31178']['case_ms']=1000;return json.dumps(d).encode()
run('单点限额放宽',limits,badlimit)
run('超限性能题误启用',catalog,cat_edit(lambda d,r:d['problems'].append({'book':'practice','id':'probe','global_number':31028,'tests':True,'test_cases':[{'input':'bad','output':'bad'}]})))
assert all(p.read_bytes()==b for p,b in backups.items())
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','unittest','tests.test_gmyhf_normal_activation'],capture_output=True,text=True);assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr
report={'mutation_count':len(rows),'results':rows,'all_original_bytes_restored':True,'restored_tests_exit_code':p.returncode,'procedure_source':Path(__file__).read_text()}
(R/'collab/gmyhf-normal-local-activation-mutations.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n');print('9种变异检出，原文件已恢复')
